newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi paper slams Israeli building in Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi paper slams Israeli building in Jerusalem.

text.p: The newspaper of Iraq's ruling Baath party al-Thawra on Friday described Israel's decision to build thousands of new homes for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem as a "new Zionist crime" against the Arab nation.
"This hostile action is a flagrant violation of U.N. Security Council resolutions on Jerusalem," Thawra declared in a front-page editorial.
"It is a new Zionist crime," Thawra said.
Israel decided on Wednesday to build 6,500 houses for Jews in Jerusalem, which Palestinians see as their future capital.
Thawra also attacked the United States, accusing it of applying double standards in its dealings with Arab countries.
It said Washington was forcing Iraq to apply U.N. resolutions in the name of international law while failing to pressure Israel to do the same.
"It is the game of double standards being manifested here in its most vicious form. What is permissible for the Zionist entity is not permissible for Arabs," Thawra said.
It urged Arab countries to close ranks and make a united stand against Israeli policies.

It said a new policy by Arab countries towards Iraq, reeling under U.N. trade sanctions for invading Kuwait in 1990 and shunned by many Arab states, would certainly put an end "to the usurpation of Arab rights".
